description:
crates/bedok has no executing physics or benchmark gate.

- crates/bedok/src/reference/cases/neacrp_a/mod.rs has 11 #[test] fns (lines 496, 505, 526, 538, 560, 578, 623, 640, 678, 703, 718). Every one is a case-BUILDER assertion: grid dims (nx==17, nz==18), axial mesh (z_total==427.3), material-map indices, TH inputs (max_power_watt == 693.75e6), rod-bank positions, feedback-table reference states, transient-schedule monotonicity, error on a coarse grid. NONE asserts k_eff, power, or flux.
- neacrp_a/tables.rs adds 6 more tests (lines 517-612), also data-integrity only.
- The physics gates exist but are all disabled: 19 #[ignore]d gates across crates/bedok/tests/benchmark/main.rs (7, e.g. :69 #[ignore = "waiting on the stage-1 reference solver"]) and tests/parity/main.rs (8). tests/benchmark/main.rs:36 states outright: "Not yet run. Every gate below is #[ignore]d".

So no parity claim can be made for bedok, and none should appear in any doc. Blocked on the seam rewiring bead.

Verified 2026-08-07 against the working tree.
title: bedok: no physics gate exists — 17 builder-only tests, 19 ignored gates never run

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
2026-09-10 (session_01AhE6XBx3nRd81aHLQrciQe): 2 of 3 files split, mechanical line-range moves with no code changes beyond visibility (pub(super)) and imports.
 - src/heatr/mod.rs (1450 lines at split time) -> heatr/{mod (97), spectra (200), kerma (154), damage (222), tests (826)}.rs: H5 emission spectra + per-MT heating-model dispatch / MT=301 KERMA (H1-H5) / MT=444 damage energy (H7) / the unit tests moved verbatim (dedented) into a #[cfg(test)] mod tests; sibling file. Module doc kept in mod.rs with the intra-doc links repointed.
 - src/wmp.rs (1404 lines) -> wmp/{mod (94), types (147), evaluate (252), h5 (171), blob (470), tests (324)}.rs: the "parsing vs Doppler-broadening evaluation" boundary the plan named - evaluate.rs holds evaluate()+faddeeva/Weideman/erf/broaden_wmp_polynomials, h5.rs load_h5, blob.rs the WMPB/WMPL formats + WmpLibrary, types.rs Cf64/WmpXs/WmpReaction/WmpWindow/WindowedMultipole. include_bytes! path adjusted (../data/wmp_core.wmpl). Public paths unchanged (crate::wmp::{WindowedMultipole, WmpLibrary, WmpXs, faddeeva, ...}; pub(crate) weideman_coeffs/weideman_l re-exported for gpu_wmp).
 - src/purr/mod.rs (now 1414 lines) DELIBERATELY NOT split this session: the URR/PURR track (op-cjw.6, op-cjw.20/.22/.23, op-as32) was being edited concurrently by another session that owns src/purr/, and a directory split under its feet would have produced a conflict on every one of its commits. Do it when that track is quiet; the plan-named boundary (ladder generation vs unrest's Monte Carlo core) still applies.
Verification: cargo check --lib --tests --examples clean; rustfmt clean on the new files; full scripts/test.sh suite green (see commit). docs/porting-plan.md section 5 table updated (heatr/wmp rows marked done with the new line counts, purr row updated to 1414 with the reason); README.md / porting-plan path references src/wmp.rs -> src/wmp/ updated. Leaving the bead OPEN for the purr third.
